sources.title: Perceiver · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The abstract from the paper is the following: The recently-proposed Perceiver model obtains good results on several domains (images, audio, multimodal, point clouds) while scaling linearly in compute and memory with the input size. While the Perceiver supports many kinds of inputs, it can only produce very simple outputs such as class scores.
